검증 범위
접근 가능한 출처·판본·표본·방법과 보고 수치 대조; New Scientist는 공개 도입부, 킬리피시 연구는 공개 초록, Moreno-Jiménez의 일부 근거는 초록·확장 그림 범위에서 확인; 원본 한영 도표와 HTML/PDF 출력 검사. 확장판은 AI 이식 세포·손상 반응 서열·축삭 재생 원전, 율리히의 지도·예후 모형, OPM/SQUID 연구와 공식 QPU 연구 계획을 대조했다. Wang 논문은 최종 초록·저자 데이터 등록 설명과 2025-10-28 프리프린트 v2를 확인했으며 최종 전문·노트북 내용은 확인하지 않았다. 조직·단일세포 원자료 분석, 원 연구의 계산 코드 재실행, 임상시험이나 재활 치료를 독립 수행하지 않았다.
사람 검토 수준
주제·작성·공개 게시 요청 확인; 문장 단위 사람 승인·독자 이해도 실험 없음.
근거 기준일
2026-10-30

세포 탄생의 관찰, 회로 기능의 연구와 임상 평가변수를 구분한다. AI 생성 표지는 개념 일러스트이며 실제 해부 영상·세포 영상·치료 결과가 아니다.

en.details:
How this review was made

Responsible editor
Hyun-Jung Kim
AI system
OpenAI Codex; exact model identifier not retained
Verifiable agent roles
root — primary-source synthesis, Korean writing, original conceptual cover, AI/quantum extension and publication integration; academic_sources — human hippocampal evidence and denominators, Jülich/personalized-brain-model sources and independent scientific audit; rehab_evidence — rehabilitation/cell-therapy clinical audit, AI cellular/axon-repair sources and complete English/extension translation; review_format — original bilingual responsive figures, font typesetting, HTML/PDF production and complete output checks; publish_audit — quantum-sensing/QPU evidence, independent cover, reader-explanation, APS-reference and publication audit
Editorial harness
AI Tech Review Editorial Harness v2026.08 · public method
Inputs and outputs
Public papers, regulatory reviews, rehabilitation guidance and official disclosures → bilingual review, conceptual cover, explanatory figures and PDFs.
Production request
Review adult human neurogenesis, recovery and rehabilitation, and extend the same cell/circuit/function question to actual AI and quantum-technology approaches at major research institutions.
Verification scope
Accessible sources, versions, samples, methods and reported values; New Scientist was checked through its public introduction, the killifish study through its public abstract, and some Moreno-Jiménez evidence through the abstract and extended figures; original bilingual figures and HTML/PDF output. The extension checked original AI graft, injury-responsive enhancer and axon-repair studies, Jülich maps/prognostic models, OPM/SQUID reports and official QPU research plans. Wang was checked through the final abstract, author-deposit descriptions and public preprint v2 of 28 October 2025; the final full text and notebook contents were not accessed. No independent tissue/single-cell raw-data analysis, rerun of the studies’ computational code, clinical trial or rehabilitation treatment.
Human review
Topic, writing and public posting requested; no line-by-line human approval or reader-comprehension study.
Evidence cutoff
2026-10-30

Cell-birth observations, circuit-function studies and clinical endpoints are distinguished. The AI-generated cover is conceptual, not anatomical imaging, cell imaging or a treatment result.
